title: test_authentication_api_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid user credentials returns a 200 status and a JWT bearer token.

title: test_viveiros_management_api_create_and_list_ponds
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/viveiros/ with valid pond data creates a new pond and GET /api/v1/viveiros/ returns a paginated list with KPIs for authenticated users.

title: test_ciclos_produtivos_api_start_pause_resume_cycle
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/ciclos/ starts a new production cycle, POST /api/v1/ciclos/{ciclo_id}/pausar pauses the cycle, and POST /api/v1/ciclos/{ciclo_id}/retomar resumes the paused cycle for authenticated users.

title: test_biometrias_api_record_and_list_biometric_samples
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/biometrias/ records a new biometric sampling with valid data and GET /api/v1/biometrias/ returns the biometric history for authenticated users.

title: test_manejo_alimentar_api_record_and_list_feeding_management
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/manejos/ records feeding distribution and observations, and GET /api/v1/manejos/ returns feeding management history for authenticated users.

title: test_custos_operacionais_api_record_and_list_operational_costs
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/custos/ records an operational cost entry with valid data and GET /api/v1/custos/ returns operational costs and financial summaries for authenticated users.

title: test_simulacao_despesca_api_execute_and_list_simulations
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/simulacao/ executes a harvest decision simulation with valid inputs and GET /api/v1/simulacao/ returns historical simulation list for authenticated users.

title: test_auditoria_api_query_audit_log_entries
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/auditoria/ returns audit log entries filtered by action, entity, or date range for authenticated users.
